name: – Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela – After § 37 – Am 54
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 37d. Recalls that, according to Oxfam, just 31 of the Union’s wealthiest individuals emit 3,469 tons of carbon each per year through the use of their superyachts and jets; recalls that this figure is 432 times more than the average European; calls on the Commission to make a new proposal to introduce a luxury carbon tax on luxury goods, including yachts, private jets and SUVs, as a new own resource; recalls that such a tax would be socially just, help mitigate climate change and could be more effective than a classic carbon tax;
